response.content: {"what_this_is": [{"text": "እዚ፦ ናይ ክፍሊት ትእዛዝ እዩ። ደብዳበ ካብ Betreibungsamt Bern-Mittelland እዩ።", "support": ["e1", "e2"]}], "what_they_want": [{"text": "CHF 1’240.00 ክትከፍሉ ይሓቱ ኣለዉ።", "support": ["e11", "e12"]}], "deadline": [{"text": "መወዳእታ መዓልቲ፦ [[DUE_DATE]]።", "support": ["e13"]}], "what_you_can_do": [{"text": "ክትከፍሉ ትኽእሉ።", "support": ["e14"]}, {"text": "ከምዘይትሰማምዑ ነቲ ቤት ጽሕፈት ክትገልጹ ትኽእሉ።", "support": ["e15"]}], "who_to_contact": [{"text": "ወግዓዊ ቤት ጽሕፈት፦ Betreibungsamt Bern-Mittelland, +41 31 635 90 00, ba.mittelland@be.ch, https://www.baka.dij.be.ch, Poststrasse 25, 3072 Ostermundigen።", "support": ["e2"]}]}
